svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A channel 80 long: web 104.8 tall, two 22 mm flanges, both folded to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front (toward the inverter). 3 mm sheet; inside bend radius 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 4.5 mm holes in each flange, 15 and 65 from the left end, 9.5

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back from the flange's front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Catch: drill the web to the catch's own holes, its centre 57 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left end and 53.8 above the underside of the foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: foot on the floor, two M4 button heads from below, nyloc nuts on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top; top flange under the shelf, two M4 screws down through the shelf.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The web's back face is 2 mm in front of the pack's latch pawl and 12 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in front of its latch face; the catch takes the pawl.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the web is square to the floor and the catch springs freely.
